data.name: Giuditta
data.long_meaning: The name Giuditta is derived from the Hebrew name Yehudit, which means 'Judah'. In the Old Testament book of Judith, the character Judith is a beautiful and brave widow who saves her people from the Assyrian general Holofernes by seducing and beheading him. The name Giuditta thus carries the meanings of Judah (Judea), judgment, and victory.
